```sql
BEGIN;

-- Add new columns if they don't exist
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_name VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_name VARCHAR(255);

-- Backfill: split full_name on first space
-- Only processes rows not yet migrated (first_name IS NULL or empty)
UPDATE users 
SET 
  first_name = split_part(full_name, ' ', 1),
  last_name = COALESCE(split_part(full_name, ' ', 2), '')
WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND (first_name IS NULL OR first_name = '');

-- Drop old column if it exists
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS full_name CASCADE;

COMMIT;
```

**Re-runnable because:**
- `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` skips if columns already exist
- `UPDATE` only touches rows with `first_name IS NULL` — already-migrated rows are skipped
- `DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS` succeeds even if column is already gone

**Edge cases handled:**
- NULL full_name: WHERE clause skips it
- Multi-word names: splits on first space only, rest goes to last_name
- Empty last name: coalesced to empty string (adjust to 'Unknown' or NULL per your domain)
- Already-dropped column: re-runs safely do nothing

```sql
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_name VARCHAR(255);
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_name VARCHAR(255);

UPDATE users 
SET 
  first_name = SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name, ' ', 1),
  last_name = COALESCE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name, ' ', 2), ' ', -1), '')
WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL 
  AND (first_name IS NULL OR first_name = '');

ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS full_name;

COMMIT;
```
